statement: Define DevRelay's ChangeIntegration module so one exactly verified work-item change is incorporated into one configured local Git target with compare-and-swap safety, immutable evidence, and no system-acceptance authority.
objectives: Integrate exactly one Gate-approved WorkItemVerification result per invocation.
Bind integration to an exact target ref and expected target commit before any mutation.
Leave the configured target unchanged on drift, conflict, invalid input, or failed integration.
Return an immutable integrated-change record, updated repository snapshot, and traceability merge proof on success.
Route conflicts back through authorized WorkExecution and WorkItemVerification without automatic resolution.
constraints: V1 integrates into a configured local Git ref; remote pull-request and merge systems remain replaceable future adapters.
Core owns compare-and-swap, validation, checkpoint replay, and lifecycle progression; adapters cannot self-approve integration.
Concurrent verified changes serialize at the target-ref compare-and-swap boundary.
No V1 adapter may automatically resolve a semantic or textual conflict.
acceptanceCriteria: One invocation binds one approved work item, exact verification approval, verified change bytes, target repository snapshot, target ref, expected target commit, and integration policy.
Target drift is detected before mutation and yields baseline_drift.
A conflict yields an IntegrationConflictSet and leaves the target ref unchanged.
Successful integration atomically advances the configured target ref and returns exact post-state evidence.
Checkpoint replay performs zero additional integration effects and cannot duplicate the change.
assumptions: The user's four approved ChangeIntegration boundary decisions are the authoritative requirements basis.
The OpenSpec adapter is used only for bounded requirements proposal and normalization; no live upstream CLI claim is made.
